items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...with Tony – Tony Williams, Woody Shaw, Black Arthur Blythe, Dexter Gordon, Stan Getz, Jimmy, Bobby Hutcherson. So you’re in another stable... [INTERVIEWEE] We all went to Havana, too.

ctx.x: Then, again, we’re talking about CBS, now at Havana Jam, where you’ve got all of those – with Tony – Tony Williams, Woody Shaw, Black Arthur Blythe, Dexter Gordon, Stan Getz, Jimmy, Bobby Hutcherson. So you’re in another stable, if we can use that term, but these are folks that made the money for CBS.
We all went to Havana, too. That’s why they called it Havana Jam.
